definitions.explanation: Official written documents, typically used in business, legal, or administrative contexts. Can refer to forms, contracts, reports, or any formal paperwork.

examples.japanese: {書類|しょるい}に{名前|なまえ}を{書|か}いてください。
examples.english: Please write your name on the documents.

examples.japanese: この{書類|しょるい}を{提出|ていしゅつ}してください。
{大切|たいせつ}な{書類|しょるい}を{失|な}くしてしまった。
{会社|かいしゃ}に{入|はい}る{前|まえ}に、たくさんの{書類|しょるい}を{準備|じゅんび}しなければなりません。
examples.english: Before joining the company, you have to prepare a lot of documents.

notes:
{書類|しょるい} is a general term for official documents, papers, or forms.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {書類|しょるい}を{提出|ていしゅつ}する: to submit documents
- {書類|しょるい}に{記入|きにゅう}する: to fill in documents
- {書類|しょるい}を{用意|ようい}する: to prepare documents

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {書類選考|しょるいせんこう}: document screening (in job applications)
- {必要|ひつよう}{書類|しょるい}: required documents
- {申請|しんせい}{書類|しょるい}: application documents
- {重要|じゅうよう}{書類|しょるい}: important documents

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {書類|しょるい}: documents (formal papers)
- {資料|しりょう}: materials, data, documents
- {文書|ぶんしょ}: written document (more formal/legal)
